#!/usr/bin/env zsh
emulate zsh -o extended_glob
repo=/home/jack/.t3/bench-runs/2026-10-02-codex-thermo-sol61-high/att-032/clone
work=/home/jack/.t3/bench-runs/2026-10-02-codex-thermo-sol61-high/att-032/clone-work/thermo-checks
raw=$(<$repo/crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh)
encodings=$(<$repo/crates/core/flags/complete/encodings.sh)
generated=${raw//\!ENCODINGS\!/$encodings}
print -r -- "$generated" > $work/_rg
rg() { print -r -- "$generated" }
print 'CASE: direct source after compinit'
(
  autoload -Uz compinit
  compinit -u -D
  source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
  result=$?
  print -r -- "status=$result mapping=$_comps[rg] function=$+functions[_rg]"
  _arguments() { print -r -- "arguments-called argc=$#"; return 0 }
  _rg
)
print 'CASE: direct source before compinit'
(
  source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
  result=$?
  print -r -- "status=$result compdef=$+functions[compdef]"
  autoload -Uz compinit
  compinit -u -D
  print -r -- "after-compinit mapping=${_comps[rg]-missing}"
)
print 'CASE: after compinit but execute literal FAQ zshrc line'
(
  autoload -Uz compinit
  compinit -u -D
  $ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
  print -r -- "status=$?"
)
print 'CASE: argument-list source without completion system'
(
  specs=$( _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 source $repo/crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh )
  print -r -- "status=$? lines=${#${(f)specs}} has-generate=${${specs[(r)*--generate=*]}:+yes}"
)
print 'CASE: argument-list source with completion system'
(
  autoload -Uz compinit
  compinit -u -D
  specs=$( _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 source $repo/crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh )
  print -r -- "status=$? lines=${#${(f)specs}}"
)
print 'CASE: first and subsequent autoload invocations after compinit'
(
  fpath=($work $fpath)
  autoload -Uz compinit
  compinit -u -D
  _arguments() { print -r -- "arguments-called argc=$#"; return 0 }
  print -r -- "mapping=$_comps[rg]"
  _rg
  print -r -- "first-status=$?"
  _rg
  print -r -- "second-status=$?"
)
print 'CASE: fpath appended after compinit, as FAQ permits'
(
  autoload -Uz compinit
  compinit -u -D
  unset '_comps[rg]'
  fpath=($work $fpath)
  print -r -- "mapping=${_comps[rg]-missing}"
)
ZSH
